title: Exponential bound on the inverse learning threshold
statement: Let $n,C,Q$ be natural numbers, let $t$ be a positive rational, and let $\varepsilon$ be rational with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. Assume $1\le n$, $1/(Q+1)\le\varepsilon$, and $t\le(C+1)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)$. Define $d=\lceil 8t/\varepsilon\rceil$ and $\tau=(\varepsilon/8)^2t^{-2}(1/9)^d$. Then $\tau^{-2}\le 2^{(((8(C+1)(Q+1))^4+8(8(C+1)(Q+1)+1)+4)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1))}$, with the right-hand side interpreted as a rational number.
